content.content: Two directions: a recording's journal entry contains exactly the target's owned set — its node file plus its array-ref paths — with no path outside it, and every one of those paths is present with the before and after side the recording left. An inline-ref target's entry contains the node file alone. The marker stores exactly one journal entry id for the recording.
content.rationale: A natural-to-code fidelity gate states the rule before the capture change and then checks the code against it. The owned set is D2's, so the capture may neither add a path nor omit one, and a recording names one entry rather than a bag of ids.
